comment: The Metric Definitions vocabulary for Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts: every metric name, its unit and its supported aggregations, as the Metric_Catalog's entries for this type must be evidenced against (Req 2.1). Derived from Microsoft documentation rather than captured from a live subscription -- see `provenance`, which records the source per fixture and the basis for the supported-aggregation set per metric. Metric names are recorded as the source's 'Name in REST API' value and never as a portal display name: the two differ by exactly the case, whitespace and separator substitutions the near-miss rule rejects, and a near miss here would make a metric permanently uncollectable.

derived_from: Microsoft Learn, 'Supported metrics - Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts' (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/reference/supported-metrics/microsoft-storage-storageaccounts-metrics): the 'Name in REST API', 'Unit', 'Aggregation', 'Dimensions' and 'Time Grains' columns. That page documents 'Aggregation' as the *default* aggregation type, which is why the supported-aggregation set carries a recorded basis per metric.

Microsoft Learn, 'Metric Definitions - List' (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/monitor/metric-definitions/list): the response shape, being the `value` array and each definition's `namespace`, `name`, `unit`, `supportedAggregationTypes`, `metricAvailabilities` and `dimensions` fields.

aggregation_bases.documented_published_set: The source publishes two or more aggregations for this metric; the set is recorded verbatim, with 'Total (Sum)' written as the REST value 'Total'.
aggregation_bases.documented_single_aggregation_treated_as: The source publishes exactly one aggregation for this metric, and publishes multi-value sets for other metrics of this same resource type -- so this resource provider does declare its supported set, and the single published value is recorded as the complete set.

provenance.selection: A subset of the metrics the source lists for this type: the utilization series this product collects, restricted to metrics whose unit is one the catalog's unit mapping covers. A subset fails closed -- a catalog entry naming a metric this fixture does not carry is rejected -- so an omission can block a metric but can never admit a wrong one. `omitted_metrics` records the candidates that were dropped and why.

omitted_metrics.name: SuccessE2ELatency, SuccessServerLatency
omitted_metrics.reason: the source reports the unit 'MilliSeconds', which the catalog's unit mapping has no term for

omitted_metrics.name: ContainerUsedSize, ContainerBlobCount
omitted_metrics.reason: the source marks both as advanced platform metrics, a separately priced tier this product does not require a customer to enable

omitted_metrics.name: MigrationProgress
omitted_metrics.reason: a migration progress indicator rather than a utilization series

omitted_fields: id and resourceId, which are fully qualified resource identifiers carrying a subscription id (Req 2.5 excludes both)

primaryAggregationType, isDimensionRequired, displayDescription, category, name.localizedValue and metricAvailabilities[].retention, none of which the source establishes -- omitted rather than invented
provenance.region_note: The source is not region-scoped. `region` records the (resource_type, region) pair this fixture stands in for, matching the Definition_Probe's cache key, and is the region the rest of this repository's Azure fixtures use.
